- Most recent churn is by James Braza, who authors nearly all task.py and litqa.py commits. Each commit title ends with a PR number, in the form "Description (#NNN)".
- The unsure-answer and evaluation flow was reworked in the past few weeks. 405f885 (#673) added an optional max_answer_attempts for an unsure branch. 9e8ed75 (#684) added the `complete` tool. 201d364 (#698) removed the "cannot answer" literals and added `reset`. A fix should build on that design and avoid reintroducing hard-coded literals.
- The unsure option and the distractor handling in litqa.py were touched recently. d704384 (#694) made sure distractors are copied. Option-list changes should not mutate shared lists.
- The prompts in prompts.py were moved there from elsewhere in 4069d38 (#681) and corrected in 59dd4a7 (#683). Keep prompt constants in prompts.py and watch for name drift.
- The metrics code in task.py has had repeated crash fixes: c8abc06, 0d75e2c, e8678a3. Guard against missing or unexpected statuses, and add tests for the edge case.
- Environments implement `__deepcopy__` (81f8c5f), and Docs must not be shared between Environments (3327821). Any new state on the environment needs to respect both.
- Types were renamed to PQASession in dcb4fd4, so use the new names.
- Lint and type checks (ruff, mypy) are enforced, as in 8eaef2e.
